name: Verisk Analytics
summary: Primary concern is high volatility, with mixed signals in other areas.

meanings.ret6m: Roughly flat over 6 months, tracking the broader market.
meanings.ret1y: Weak 1-year performance, lagging the broader market.
meanings.fromHigh: Notable decline from 52-week high, under pressure.
meanings.rsi14: Approaching overbought levels — strong buying pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Above 2 of 3 averages — mostly bullish structure.
meanings.macd: MACD negative but improving — downtrend may be slowing.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: Low beta — relatively insulated from broad market swings.
meanings.mdd1y: Large 1-year drawdown — significant decline from peak.
meanings.sharpe: Poor risk-adjusted return — losses or gains don't justify the volatility.
meanings.pe: Moderate P/E ratio — fairly valued relative to current earnings.
meanings.peVsSector: Above the sector median — more expensive than typical peers.
meanings.margin: Strong profit margin, well above most industries.
meanings.roe: Data not available for this indicator.
meanings.de: Data not available for this indicator.
meanings.liquidity: Moderate liquidity — sufficient for most trades.
